name: Guardant Health
type: Precision oncology and liquid biopsy company
leader: Helmy Eltoukhy and AmirAli Talasaz, co-CEOs
employees: Growth-stage precision-oncology workforce; see 2025 annual report
financial: FY2025 revenue $982.0M, up 33%; non-GAAP gross margin 66%; cash and marketable securities $1.3B
geography: U.S.-led with expanding international launches and partnerships
position: Liquid-biopsy leader spanning advanced cancer, recurrence monitoring and cancer screening
pricing: Reimbursement-driven clinical testing, biopharma service contracts and data licensing; screening economics depend on coverage and adoption.
innovation: Deep focus on blood-based genomics, AI-enabled molecular data, MRD and multi-cancer screening.
marketing: Oncology KOL engagement, clinical evidence, biopharma alliances, screening awareness and specialist commercial teams.
distribution: Central laboratories, specimen kits, oncology practice integration and expanding international partner channels.
customer: Strong perception for minimally invasive testing and speed; coverage, out-of-pocket cost and interpretation remain adoption factors.
operations: High-complexity sequencing and data platform with commercial oncology, biopharma and screening businesses.

name: Tempus AI
employees: Rapidly scaling technology, laboratory and clinical workforce; see 2025 10-K
financial: 2025 preliminary data-and-applications revenue ~$316M; total contract value >$1.1B
geography: U.S.-centered with growing global biopharma relationships
position: Multimodal clinical-data and AI platform combining diagnostics, data licensing and workflow applications
pricing: Mix of reimbursed diagnostics, subscription/application contracts and enterprise data-licensing agreements.
innovation: Core differentiation is multimodal data, machine learning and integration of molecular, clinical, imaging and outcomes information.
marketing: Technology-leadership narrative, biopharma partnerships, clinical publications, enterprise sales and high-profile AI positioning.
distribution: Health-system software integrations, direct diagnostic ordering and enterprise biopharma contracts.
customer: Strong innovation perception and integrated-data promise; implementation complexity, interoperability and data governance are key adoption concerns.
operations: Combines regulated laboratories, large-scale data engineering, cloud software and enterprise contracting.
moves: Expansion of AI applications and multimodal datasets

name: BioReference Health
financial: 2025 diagnostic-services revenue $370.3M after major asset divestitures
geography: Core New York and New Jersey clinical market plus national 4Kscore and correctional-health services
position: Restructured regional laboratory focused on NY/NJ, urology and selected specialty services
products: Women’s health and selected specialty testing
pricing: Regional payer and client contracts plus specialty-test reimbursement; 4Kscore economics depend on coverage and physician adoption.
innovation: Focused innovation around 4Kscore and specialist testing after divesting broader U.S. and oncology assets to Labcorp.
marketing: Regional sales relationships, urology-focused education and specialty-service positioning.
distribution: Regional NY/NJ laboratory and courier infrastructure with national specialty-kit fulfillment.
customer: Local service and specialty expertise are strengths; restructuring and divestitures may affect continuity and market perception.
operations: Leaned-down regional operating model after closing facilities and reducing workforce; emphasis on profitability and core franchises.
moves: Sold broad U.S. testing assets to Labcorp in 2024
Sold oncology diagnostics assets to Labcorp in 2025
Refocused on NY/NJ, 4Kscore and correctional health

name: Fulgent Genetics
employees: Specialty laboratory and technology workforce; see latest annual report
financial: Public growth-stage diagnostics company; current figures available through investor relations
geography: U.S. laboratories with international genetic-testing reach
position: Technology-led specialty diagnostics company spanning hereditary genetics, oncology and laboratory services
pricing: Fee-for-service and payer-reimbursed testing, institutional contracts and selected direct-pay offerings.
